display_name: Dark Forest Frontier V2 — Terrain & Props (low-ground tier)
tier_note: This profile covers the dark-ink low-ground tier only. Per the art bible's 'Two deliberate tiers' decision (2026-08-11), high-ground/plateau assets should use a brighter glass-mushroom palette instead — no sibling high-ground profile exists yet; write prompts by hand against the art bible's high-ground palette table until one does.
style_reference: Darkest Dungeon 2 painterly NPR, executed for real this time: bold black ink outlines (inverted-hull proxy) plus flat/matte fill colors actually assigned to the mesh, not Meshy's raw PBR texture left untouched.
goal: A vampiric forest that is full of life, not a desaturated dead one — rich living greens (moss, fern, undergrowth) as the dominant environmental color, black bark for structure and silhouette, and sinister blood red as the one recurring accent family (not magenta/pink). Cyan stays reserved for KON-owned/base-adjacent elements only, the single non-red accent in the whole biome. Every prompt should be built from the template in the art bible, not written freehand. See DARK_FOREST_FRONTIER_V2_ART_BIBLE.md 'Palette correction — 2026-08-12' for the full reasoning.

prompt_requirements: orthographic or three-quarter top-down game-asset reference framing
clean isolated silhouette, no ground plane clutter beyond the asset itself
large readable shapes — must be identifiable at RTS zoomed-out camera distance
no UI, text, frame, heavy background, or tiny surface detail
rich living green foliage where the subject calls for it — this is a forest full of life, not a dead husk
at most one controlled red-family emissive accent per asset (or none) — never magenta/pink, cyan only for KON-owned assets
meshy_guidance.positive_prompt: stylized vampiric dark fantasy RTS terrain prop, Darkest-Dungeon-2-like painterly inked rendering, bold black ink outline, strong readable silhouette, chunky shapes, matte black bark and vivid living moss/fern green, sinister blood-red accent where appropriate, orthographic game asset reference, high contrast shadows, no photorealism
meshy_guidance.negative_prompt: photorealistic, glossy plastic, noisy AI texture, tiny surface detail, soft low-contrast silhouette, desaturated dead colors, magenta, pink, purple, bright cheerful colors, modern materials, sci-fi, UI, text, watermark, realistic photo-scan look

mesh_processing._discard_imported_materials_note: Was false through 2026-08-11 — the actual bug behind the flat grey-blue look Andrew flagged: ensure_materials() in blender_process_prop.py only assigns the palette to the mesh when this is true. With it false, Meshy's raw PBR texture rendered untouched and the curated palette below was never applied to any visible geometry at all.
mesh_processing._outline_scale_note: Raised from 1.03 — too subtle to read as a real DD2 ink line at RTS camera distance, especially now that flat-color fill will make the outline the main source of silhouette definition.

moss.note: vivid living green, not desaturated — this is the primary 'full of life' color, use generously

wood_bark.note: near-black, the primary silhouette/structure color — bark, trunks, roots, twisted wood

accent_base.note: cyan — the ONLY non-red accent in the biome. Reserve for BASE_PLOT_MARKER and other KON-owned/base-adjacent assets only, do not use generically.

accent_corrupted.note: deep sinister blood red (was magenta/pink through 2026-08-11 — corrected per Andrew's 'sinister red, not magenta' direction). Use for content/mystery/vampiric-corruption-coded assets — the ambient, brooding red.

accent_hostile.note: hot ember/blood red, brighter and more saturated than accent_corrupted — hostile/Deom-coded assets, outpost markers, danger. Same red family as accent_corrupted, distinguished by intensity not hue.

godot_expectations.lighting: cool moonlit key light, blood-red fill near corrupted/vampiric features (was documented as magenta — correct to red per the 2026-08-12 palette fix)
godot_expectations.camera: orthographic top-down preview plus in-game readability check at default RTS zoom
godot_expectations.pivot_convention: per BLENDER_EXPORT_GUIDE.md by category — tile-center-at-top-surface for ground markers/terrain tiles, tile-center-at-ground for props/blockers, trunk-base for trees
godot_expectations.animation_status: not applicable — static props/terrain, no rig or animation needed
